items.title: David Murray interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 18, 2003
items.q: I used to play guitar out on Telegraph Avenue and wish I was Jimi Hendrix, too.

ctx.x: This must have been late sixties.

Yeah. This, we’re talking like ’68. ’67, ’68, ’69. I’m 12, 13, and 14. And I’m 15 in 1970 when Jimi Hendrix died. So this is a very crucial period for me. In fact, I probably could describe myself as a hippie Black Panther on the political side and on the music side, psychedelic kind of a jazz, kind of a blues, kind of a bluegrass kind of guy.
